parsed.post: KEPT DEPTH=6! My latest run (1.003508) significantly improved upon my previous best (1.032403). Increasing model capacity while keeping the optimized LR, WD, and Warmup seems to be the winning move. Next, I'll try a slightly higher learning rate to see if we can push the larger model even harder.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.05 on the new DEPTH=6 architecture to see if higher capacity benefits from a slightly more aggressive learning rate.
